name: QUOTIENT_CANONICALIZE
observed_tension: OBSERVED: a 227 KB learned digit model reached HC_D 0.91 on unseen targets in T_7 with no identifiable coordinate; after quotienting by the exact metric symmetry (domain relabelling by S_7), 11,140,836 reachable (f,t) pairs collapse to 25,382 orbit classes on which the shortest distance D is exactly constant; a 34,800-byte lookup table on those classes navigates at oracle cost (HC_D 0.997-0.999, zero failures, excess path 0.00) and explains R^2 0.89 of the learned model and 0.77 of what it added over CP rank 16.
candidate_mechanism: DISCOVER a consequence-preserving transformation -> VERIFY it mechanically on the exact chart -> FACTOR OUT nuisance distinctions -> MAP each problem to a canonical representative -> SEARCH in the quotient -> RESTORE a concrete representative only when required -> VERIFY the result exactly.
consequential_claim: OBSERVED (one ecology): a verified consequence-preserving transformation can collapse many superficially distinct reasoning states into a much smaller quotient so that navigation operates on consequential equivalence classes rather than raw states. Search burden altered: kernel-aware search 87.5 transitions -> 37.1 (oracle 37.0) per problem on HELD_STATES.
verified_invariants: D(f o sigma, t o sigma) = D(f, t) for all sigma in S_7: 0 violations on 176,540 random tests; 0 canonical classes with inconsistent D (OBSERVED)
no non-trivial VALUE relabelling preserves the metric: generator set {7-cycle, swap(0,1), collapse 0->1} has trivial conjugation stabiliser, computed over all 5040 permutations (OBSERVED)
reachability == no f-value straddles both target blocks in the contingency table: 0 of 25,382 reachable orbits straddle (OBSERVED)
every claimed solution is engine-verified; failures 0 on every held set (OBSERVED)
boring_explanations: the orbit table IS an exact table lookup on a 25,382-entry function; the compression is entirely the symmetry, nothing was learned (this is the intended reading, not a confound)
the target set (rank-2 restricted-growth maps) and the corpus (rank >= 3 starts) are one regime; orbit count and compressibility may not transfer
the wall-clock does not improve: 0.11 ms per decision vs 0.56 us per raw transition expansion (~200x slower); the gain is in inference count only
failure_geometry: OBSERVED (AC-01D-v2 run 1, preserved as V2_orbit_table_BUG_run1_rank2_missing.json): a table built from the rank>=3 corpus missed the 2,646 rank-2 reachable pairs, the last step before every target; exact on every scored row yet navigated at 150x oracle cost. Coverage of the quotient at the search frontier, not on the scored rows, is the binding contract.

OBSERVED (independent lineage, whitepapers/orbit_canonicalization.md, exploratory/tensor_decomp_qd/META_REPORT_DIRECTION_2.md): a gauge-invariant canonicaliser for tensor decompositions was built, validated 50/50, and removed a scaling barrier, yet the QD search bottleneck was unchanged -- 'mutation geometry is the proven bottleneck, not canonicalization'. The organism can be exactly correct and consequentially inert when the search cost lives in the move set, not in the state multiplicity.

OBSERVED: additivity fails inside the quotient: linear/additive summaries of collapse depth and orbit coordinates reach only R^2 0.52-0.57 on D; the full joint table is required. Quotienting exposed the coordinate system; it did not make the function simple.

OBSERVED (v1 dissection, withdrawn): a plausible-looking symmetry (value relabelling fixing {0,1} setwise) was tested before being verified as a symmetry; it was not one. Verification of the transformation must precede its use.
cheapest_kill_experiment: Not a T_7 refinement. Promotion depends on the organism reappearing or paying under a DIFFERENT pressure: apply the same discover->verify->quotient->search->restore loop to a nursery cousin's world where the incumbent search cost is known (e.g. NUR-004 Diomedes pair-quotient, NUR-006 Lehmer factor-first), and measure whether search cost falls or, as in the tensor-QD lineage, stays put.
oracle_verifier: exact D chart by reverse BFS; exact symmetry check on the chart; engine verification of every navigated path
expected_cost: T_7 evidence complete (minutes to reproduce); cousin tests costed in their own entries
promotion_condition: independent rediscovery or measured search reduction in >= 2 ecologies with different failure geometry; and at least one ecology where the quotient is NOT the whole answer (so the organism composes rather than replaces)
kill_condition: in every non-T_7 ecology tried the quotient is either trivial (no collapse) or inert (collapse without search reduction, as in tensor-QD); or a consumer that would use the canonical representative cannot be named
descendant_if_positive: a Techne primitive-candidate proposal (techne/registry/primitive_candidates/, per the Atalanta charter route; never a direct registry write) with the two-ecology evidence and the coverage contract
descendant_if_negative: retained as a T_7 specimen with the tensor-QD inert case beside it: 'exactness of a quotient does not imply consequential reduction' becomes the recorded lesson
relation_to_existing: whitepapers/orbit_canonicalization.md (2026-04): same transformation, independent lineage, different verdict (inert for its search); this is the organism's first recorded recurrence
prometheus_math/LEHMER_PRECISION_LADDER_RESULTS.md: a different transformation (factor over Z first) with the same shape (transform, then the hard step becomes easy); see NUR-006
roles/Diomedes CYCLE_003/004: within-pair coordinates work, cross-pair coordinates are anti-predictive; a quotient by pair may be the missing canonicalisation; see NUR-004
orthogonality: What it transforms that current organisms do not: state multiplicity under a verified symmetry. What it does NOT transform: the move set (tensor-QD), the function's internal complexity (T_7 non-additivity), or wall-clock.

provenance.evidence_levels: all numbers OBSERVED in committed JSON; the mechanism statement is INFERRED from one ecology plus one independent inert recurrence; generality is UNTESTED

name: COMPILE_REPEATED_TRAJECTORY

candidate_mechanism: detect a multi-step operation that recurs across successful traces; compile it into an atomic operator; re-search with the enlarged move set; verify solutions exactly.
consequential_claim: OBSERVED in one substrate: compiling a recurring trajectory into a primitive changes the MOVE SET, which is exactly the lever the quotient organism (NUR-001) cannot reach (tensor-QD found mutation geometry, not representation, was its bottleneck).
verified_invariants: compiled operator = composition of verified operators, so soundness is inherited (OBSERVED in the incubation contract)
random length-matched macro control exists and is negative (OBSERVED)
boring_explanations: the macro was constructed with knowledge of the task family (the 'experienced' learner saw related tasks); the 600x acquisition gap may be prior knowledge, not compilation per se
meet-in-the-middle gains are the classic sqrt reduction and would appear for any bidirectional operator

name: SAME_SCORE_DISJOINT_FAILURES_PROBE

origin.experiment: AC-01D-v1 families CP r16 vs C6 DSL; Diomedes; Ludus; zoo conjecture GP

observed_tension: TESTED HERE (OBSERVED): CP rank 16 and the evolved DSL score alike (R^2 0.528 / 0.584, exact 0.202 / 0.210) but their errors correlate at 0.82; both-exact 7.8% vs 4.2% expected if independent; stacking them yields R^2 0.597 (+0.01). They are two views of ONE coarse coordinate (the low-order part of the NUR-001 orbit function), not orthogonal mechanisms. ELSEWHERE (OBSERVED, not re-tested): Diomedes per-pair coefficient vectors have mean cosine 0.065 and a model fit on one relation type is anti-predictive on the other (0.4885); Ludus circuit r0011 scores 0.25 in one world and 0.94 in another; zoo GP aggregate top-5 and Pareto front promote nearly complementary sets.
candidate_mechanism: measure error correlation / failure-set overlap between equally-scoring mechanisms BEFORE ensembling or promoting; orthogonal failures are where composition can pay.
consequential_claim: diagnostic, not a search mechanism: it selects which pairs of organisms are worth composing.
verified_invariants: error correlation and both-exact rate are computed on the same held rows with the same oracle (OBSERVED)
boring_explanations: equal scores with independent failures are rare when both mechanisms see the same features; expect high error correlation by default
failure_geometry: in AC-01 the probe found no orthogonality; the diagnostic worked, the hoped-for tension did not exist
cheapest_kill_experiment: already run for CP vs C6 (negative). Remaining cheap instance: Diomedes CYCLE_003/004 rows -- compute failure-set Jaccard between the per-pair models (files exist; minutes).
promotion_condition: a pair with equal aggregate score and error correlation < 0.3 whose stacked model beats both by more than CI width
kill_condition: no such pair in the evidence base
descendant_if_positive: a composition crucible on that pair
descendant_if_negative: AC-01 negative preserved: CP and C6 are the same coordinate
relation_to_existing: NUR-001 (both CP and C6 are approximations to its object)

name: QUOTIENT_BY_PAIR_BEFORE_FITTING
observed_tension: OBSERVED: a global 5-feature logistic (0.5633) is indistinguishable from its single best input (0.5626) and 18 relational features make it worse (0.5588); but WITHIN a single invariant pair the same cheap coordinates reach 0.6600, and 0.7101 conditioned on pair x relation, while per-pair coefficient vectors are mutually orthogonal (cosine 0.065) and a model fit on one relation type is anti-predictive on the other (0.4885). Recorded explanation: the global model averages coefficients whose signs disagree.
candidate_mechanism: the same NUR-001 loop applied to a fitting problem: identify the nuisance axis (pair identity / relation type) along which the consequential map changes sign; canonicalise by it (fit per class, or transform features to a class-invariant form) before any global model.
consequential_claim: HYPOTHESIZED: the h1 'ceiling' is a representation artefact of pooling sign-disagreeing classes, so the true attainable is >= 0.71, not 0.56. That is a headroom claim, checkable from existing rows.
verified_invariants: per-pair and per-relation fits already exist with intervals excluding chance (OBSERVED)
boring_explanations: per-class fits overfit small classes (check with the existing per-pair n)
the 0.7101 figure conditions on labels available only post hoc (relation type): if relation type is not observable at decision time the gain is not usable
failure_geometry: OBSERVED (CYCLE_005): b2 commutation is 97% determined by which operators (marginal 0.789 -> conditional 0.974), disposition PARK 'underpowered by landscape' -- a quotient can be exact and leave no headroom
cheapest_kill_experiment: CRUCIBLE-C: re-fit Diomedes h1 with pair (and, if decision-time-observable, relation type) as the canonical class; compare pooled 0.5633 vs class-canonical accuracy under the same permutation null; kill if the gain is inside the null or if the class label is not available at decision time.
expected_cost: minutes to an hour on existing rows
promotion_condition: class-canonical model beats pooled by more than the permutation-null width AND the class is decision-time-observable
kill_condition: gain is post-hoc only, or inside the null
descendant_if_positive: second-ecology evidence for NUR-001 in a statistical rather than combinatorial world
descendant_if_negative: the Diomedes ceiling is genuine; record that pooling was not the cause

Diomedes (origin; seat currently PARKED)

failure_geometry: OBSERVED (pivot phase3 D/EFG): redesigning to escape the counter produced deltas that failed a pair-aware permutation null (p 0.105; triplet lift below null mean)
cheapest_kill_experiment: no new experiment: adopt as a preregistration step (the AC-01 baselines section already does this). Kill condition is procedural: an experiment that scored a mechanism without first reporting its minimal shadow.
promotion_condition: N/A (a discipline, not an organism); recorded so the shape is nameable

name: FACTOR_FIRST_REPRESENTATION_INVERSION
observed_tension: OBSERVED: direct root-finding on 17 flagged degree-14 polynomials converges 0/17 at every dps in {30,40,50,60,80,100} (204 root-find calls); factoring over Z first converges 17/17 already at dps 30 (15 cyclotomic-only, 2 confirmed in band); 17 of 43 band entries carrying verification_failed and the resulting INCONCLUSIVE verdict were at least partly an artefact of not factoring.
candidate_mechanism: when a numerical/search step fails under escalation, test whether an exact algebraic decomposition (here: squarefree/irreducible factorisation) removes the obstruction outright; the obstruction was a repeated/clustered root, invisible to precision but trivial to factorisation.
consequential_claim: OBSERVED: a deterministic exact transformation converts an unbounded escalation ladder into a constant-cost step. This is NUR-001's shape (transform, then the hard thing is easy) with a DIFFERENT transformation (factorisation, not symmetry) and a different failure it removes (numerical degeneracy, not multiplicity).
verified_invariants: Mahler measure is multiplicative over factors, so factor-first is exact, not approximate (mathematical fact; verified 17/17 in the ladder)
boring_explanations: this is standard numerical practice; the tension is that the pipeline's escalation ladder never included it, so the lesson is about the ladder's move set, not about factorisation
failure_geometry: only tested on the 17 flagged entries; polynomials whose failure is not a repeated root would not be helped
cheapest_kill_experiment: CRUCIBLE-D: re-run the full 43-entry band with factor-first as the FIRST rung; count verdict changes; then apply the same 'escalate vs decompose' question to one other stalled Prometheus ladder (candidate: the BSD rank policies saturating at the class prior, prometheus_math/BSD_*_RESULTS.md) as a transfer probe.
oracle_verifier: exact factorisation over Z plus Mahler multiplicativity
expected_cost: minutes for the 43 entries; the BSD transfer probe is design-only until a decomposition candidate is named
promotion_condition: a second stalled ladder where an exact decomposition, not more compute, removes the stall
kill_condition: no second instance; or factor-first changes no verdict beyond the 17
descendant_if_positive: a 'decompose before escalating' rung in Techne's ladder ledger (techne/loop/rung_notes/LADDER_CLAIMS_LEDGER.md), consumer named
descendant_if_negative: the 17-entry correction stands alone as a bug-class note
relation_to_existing: NUR-001 (same shape, different transformation)
techne ladder ledger 'cheaper-mechanism' law (competitor-relative form)
orthogonality: removes numerical-degeneracy obstructions that no symmetry quotient touches

observed_tension: OBSERVED: organism accuracy 100/120 = 0.8333 equals the exact closure ceiling of its 18-operator vocabulary (484,218 joint states exhausted); exhaustive enumeration of 1,737,000 pipelines finds nothing above evolution's 0.833 with an identical per-subset profile (537x more evaluations); a hypothesis class expresses 4/16 of surveyed known structure and found 2/2 expressible, 0/12 inexpressible laws; Lehmer proxy concentration inverts at degree 14.
candidate_mechanism: when a score sits exactly at a computable closure ceiling of the vocabulary, more search is provably useless; the lever is a new primitive (change of basis), and candidates must escape the closure (NEW=1) AND survive a permutation null (Lexis: 4 claimed -> 0 survived).
consequential_claim: diagnostic: distinguishes 'search harder' from 'change representation' by computing the closure ceiling exactly.
verified_invariants: closure exhausted exactly (OBSERVED, 484,218 states)
boring_explanations: battery contamination (Apollo E9) can make a ceiling look like capability
failure_geometry: OBSERVED: all three LLM-authored escaping primitives had delta 0 after the null
cheapest_kill_experiment: no new experiment: T_7 v2 is an instance (C5's residual over the orbit table is 0; the table is the closure). Kill condition procedural.
